hero.title: Competitiveness
hero.description: How Aparri compares with other towns of the same size in the national Cities and Municipalities Competitiveness Index (CMCI), year by year and topic by topic.

content.intro: Every year, the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) scores cities and towns on five areas: the local economy, government services, infrastructure, disaster readiness, and innovation. Aparri is compared with other 1st and 2nd class municipalities across the country. A lower rank number is better: 1st is the best.

overview.title: How Aparri Did
overview.description: Pick a year to see Aparri's overall placement and how it changed from the year before.

pillars.title: What the Score Is Made Of
pillars.description: The overall score adds up five areas. Tap an area to see the 10 measures behind it.

trend.title: Aparri's Rank, 2018-2024
trend.description: A rising line means Aparri moved up or down the rankings. Rank 1st is at the top.

peers.title: Compared with Nearby 1st Class Towns
peers.description: How Aparri placed in other nearby 1st class municipalities.

terms.description: The Cities and Municipalities Competitiveness Index, a yearly DTI ranking of how ready Philippine cities and towns are for business, jobs and growth.
Aparri's place among 1st and 2nd class municipalities nationwide. 1st is the best; a smaller number is better.
Points earned in each area. The overall score is the five area scores added together; a higher score is better.
The share of similar towns that placed below Aparri. For example, 'ahead of 37%' means Aparri ranked higher than 37 out of every 100 similar towns.
For some measures, many towns get the same score, such as all towns with an approved plan. These towns share a rank, so a rank like 2nd can be held by many towns.
From 2018 to 2021, the index had four areas worth 25% each. Innovation was added in 2022, making five areas worth 20% each, and some measures were renamed. Ranks are the fairest way to compare years.

content.sourceNote: All figures come from the DTI CMCI website. DTI did not publish 2018 scores, or 2018 measure details for government services, infrastructure and disaster readiness, so only ranks are shown for those.
